lessons.advice: If Astropy reproduction tests fail during import, diagnose environment and build failures separately from the separability bug. Missing `erfa`, an unbuilt `_compiler` extension, and unavailable build dependencies blocked direct checkout execution in this trajectory. Do not treat a zero shell pipeline exit status as a successful build when the output contains a traceback. If testing a patched source module inside an installed Astropy package, run the reproduction script outside the unbuilt source tree and explicitly distinguish that installed-package validation from validation of the checkout itself.
